notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.

This is GOG hardware V3 (LiVE): default channels Pedal 7, Manual I 8, Manual II 9, Manual III 10, stops/accessories 16 (not 12). CC7 general volume (40-127) is sent but its channel is not stated, so no master volume is mapped.
Manual I (lowest) is mapped to the Choir role, Manual II to Great and Manual III to Swell. AGO console (32-note pedal, three swell shoes; only Manual III's CC11 is mapped).
The website lists Manual I "Principal 8'" twice and Manual III "Octave 4'" twice; both duplicates are entered as printed (the second gets a tag). Check the real tab names on your console.
Mixture/Cornet/Scharff ranks are not published (entered without ranks; Cornet entered at 8').

MIDI scheme: Johannus LiVE 2T-A/3T-A user manual (December 2021, hardware GOG V3), MIDI specifications pp. 48-49 (LiVE 3T-A: Pedal 7, Manual I 8, Manual II 9, Manual III 10, accessories 16; CC11 55-127): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/42313-SghAdbZtH5Mr1ZD6diBBXIHGyQD9pmQTpeC07Y6zHZfwhEBGggPcF32PWYTzfZEI-0/LiVE%202T-A%20-%203T-A%20EN%20Usermanual.pdf
